title: Ball's collision speed
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) is correctly given as √(1.5gh) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Maximum height reached
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) is correctly given as h/4.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important: The initial gravitational potential energy (mgh) is equated to the sum of kinetic energies of the ball and trough before collision.

title: Momentum conservation setup
description: Important: Horizontal momentum conservation (m*v1 = 3m*v2) is applied for the system before the collision.

title: Post-collision system analysis
description: Important: For part (2), applies both energy and momentum conservation to the ball-trough system after the elastic bounce to find the common final speed.

title: Correct relative velocity
description: Important: Recognizes that the ball's speed relative to the wall (and thus the trough) is the same before and after the elastic collision.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Final answers are expressed with correct dimensions (speed and length) and consistent use of given variables (g, h).

title: Ignoring horizontal momentum
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution assumes only the ball has kinetic energy, neglecting the trough's motion and momentum conservation.

title: Sign error in bounce
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the reversal of the ball's horizontal velocity relative to the trough is mishandled in the post-collision momentum equation.
